events.title: Double Skunk is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Steam Next Fest runs until October 26, and the free Double Skunk demo is part of it. What's in the demo You play five rivals on the way to the Parlor Cup, and Big Brenda is the last of them. Each match starts with you picking a powerup and a consumable (a one-use card), and partway around each board you can stop at the Pedlar's shop. Never played cribbage? events.title: v0.10.23: Lap Gold and House Scores
events.summary: I wanted every lap shop in a weekly challenge to give you a choice. It used to open with an empty purse, so selling your cards back was all you could do there. Added Weekly challenges and practice runs now pay 10 gold each time your peg finishes a lap. Your peg stops at the gate, the gold flies to your purse, and the lap shop opens with something to spend. events.title: v0.10.22: A home for the weekly challenge
events.summary: I measured the ten weekly challenges. For a player who didn't build around the kit, eight leaned hard toward the rival and two leaned hard the other way, so I rebuilt every kit. The challenges were also hard to find and needed the online board to play at all, so they now have their own page and you can practice any of them offline. events.title: Dev diary: how the warm-up teaches cribbage in two hands
events.summary: Cribbage has a reputation for being hard to learn. The rules are easy enough. The hard part is counting your hand. You add up fifteens, pairs, runs and flushes all at once, out loud, while your opponent listens for anything you missed. So I made the warm-up skip the rules talk and deal you a hand. Hand one is the Coach's The Coach plays the first hand with you, one short step at a time. events.title: The free Double Skunk demo is out now
events.summary: The free demo of Double Skunk is out now. It's the real game, but the campaign stops at the Parlor Cup. What's in it Five rivals. Aunt Beryl Buns, Sergeant Snip, Tatty Topaz, Cousin Mab, and Big Brenda, who keeps the Parlor Cup on top of her fridge. Powerups and consumables. Every campaign match starts with you picking a powerup and a consumable (a one-use card). The demo has some of the powerups and all of the consumables. The weekly challenge.
